## 1

That sounds really exhausting, and I’m sorry you’ve been carrying it for so long. Before you make a final decision tomorrow, would you be willing to talk tonight and think through your options? If the job is harming your health, leaving may be the right choice—but you might also be able to take a day off, speak with your manager or HR, or make a plan that gives you more financial breathing room. Whatever you decide, you don’t have to figure it out alone.

## 2

I understand why some images or institutions might make you skeptical, but the evidence for a round Earth doesn’t depend on trusting a single photograph or space agency. Ships disappear over the horizon from the bottom up, different stars are visible at different latitudes, Earth’s shadow on the Moon during lunar eclipses is round, and people have measured Earth’s curvature and circumference for thousands of years. Today, independent companies, universities, and countries launch satellites and track them, and ordinary people can observe their effects. It’s reasonable to question evidence, but the flat-Earth idea would require many unrelated observations and experiments to be falsified in a coordinated way.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it is actually made of many colors, like the colors in a rainbow. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny molecules of air. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more easily than red or orange light, so blue light reaches our eyes from all across the sky.

That is why the sky usually looks blue during the day. At sunset, sunlight travels through much more atmosphere. Most of the blue light gets scattered away before it reaches us, leaving more reds, oranges, and pinks.

## 4

雨下了一整夜，城市像浸在一片深蓝色的水里。路灯被雨幕揉碎，昏黄的光落在积水中，随着车轮驶过，荡开一圈圈细小的波纹。屋檐不断滴水，像迟缓而规律的钟声。远处偶尔传来汽车驶过湿路的声响，随后又被雨声吞没。窗玻璃蒙着薄雾，我捧着热茶坐在灯下，看树影在风中摇晃。这样的夜晚有些寂寞，却也让人感到安静，仿佛世界暂时放慢了脚步。
